source.title: The Northern Herald, 14 January 1928, p. 2 ("Mr. M'Alpine Elected to U.D.C."); Belfast News-Letter, 6 January 1928, p. 8 ("Municipal Elections")
source.publisher: The Northern Herald (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Report of the Newtownards Local Employment Committee congratulates Mr. M'Alpine 'on his unopposed return to the Newtownards U.D.C.' The Belfast News-Letter's result report of 17 January says there was only one contest in Newtownards, in Scrabo Ward.

note: Annual election of the Newtownards Urban Council, January 1928. One seat was vacant in each of the five wards. Castle and Scrabo were both contested at nomination, but by polling day the only contest was in Scrabo Ward; W. M'Alpine was returned unopposed for Castle Ward. At nomination W. M'Alpine and J. Jamison had both been nominated for Castle Ward; the contest did not proceed to the poll. Returned unopposed.
